text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic adult male, dark brown loose center-parted wavy hair, blue-gray eyes, thick eyebrows, long defined jaw, clean-shaven face. Black fine-knit long-sleeved crewneck sweater, black straight tailored trousers, black leather Chelsea boots. Naturally long legs with balanced thighs and shins, compact torso, approximately 7.5 to 8 heads tall, normal head and neck, proportional arms and hands. Exactly three complete front, right-facing profile and back full-body views, equal crown and sole heights, landscape 3:2. White seamless studio, soft even light and ground shadows, level long-lens perspective, detailed skin and fabric, full hair and shoes, no text or watermark.
original_prompt: Create a photorealistic character turnaround sheet of the same adult male, with exactly THREE complete full-body views side-by-side: front, strict right-facing side profile, back. Image 1 is the USER APPROVED full-body master and is authoritative for exact body proportions, longer legs, compact torso, silhouette, clothing fit and footwear. Image 2 supports facial identity only. Match Image 1's proportions precisely across all three views: long but natural thighs and lower legs, moderate head size, natural neck and arms, sweater ending at the same hip level. Do not revert to the older shorter-leg proportions. Preserve his center-parted wavy dark brown hair, blue-gray eyes, strong brows, clean-shaven defined face, black fine-knit long-sleeved crewneck sweater, black straight tailored trousers and black leather Chelsea boots. Relaxed neutral standing, both arms naturally down, fingers anatomically correct. Three views have identical crown and sole heights, consistent waist/crotch/knee heights. Front looks at camera, side looks horizontally to right, back faces directly away. All three complete from hair to boot soles with generous separation, white seamless studio, subtle ground contact shadows, soft even light, long-lens level perspective. Real skin and knit texture, realistic trouser seams and folds. Landscape 3:2, no text, no borders, no extra angles, no accessories.
